newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Greater Asia B up 10.87 pct at 2.55 pesos.
newsitem.headline: Greater Asia B up 10.87 pct at 2.55 pesos.

text.p: Gaming firm Greater Asia Resources Corp shares rose by 25 centavos, or 10.87 percent, to 2.55 pesos at midsession on Friday on rumours of a buy-in by businessman-politician Eduardo Cojuangco, brokers said.
When asked about the rumours, Greater Asia's finance manager Leilani Carino declined comment.
"It's for our new president to say," she said.
The firm's newly-appointed president Antonio Gatmaitan was not immediately available.
Brokers said the buy in rumours by Cojuangco, which first started last week, triggered fresh buying on Friday because of a reshuffling in the Philippine Senate.
Cojuangco is known to be close to Senator Ernesto Maceda, who on Thursday was appointed president of the Senate, or upper house of the legislature.
About 45 minutes before the market could close, Greater Asia B shares rose even further, quoting at 2.70 pesos, up 40 centavos or 17.39 percent from the previous close.
Its A shares were up 36 centavos, or 17.14 percent, at 2.46 pesos.
